description: This source file defines the 'Table' class within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Tables namespace. The class represents a table in a document, providing functionality for creating, copying, and manipulating table elements such as rows, columns, borders, shading, and other stylistic properties.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Represents a table in a document, encapsulating properties and methods to define and manipulate table structure and appearance.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the table object.

methods.name: AddColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column to the table.

methods.name: AddColumn (with width)
methods.description: Adds a new column with a specified width.

methods.name: AddRow
methods.description: Adds a new row to the table.

methods.name: SetShading
methods.description: Sets shading color for a specified range of cells.

methods.name: SetEdge
methods.description: Sets borders for a specified range of cells.

properties.name: Columns
properties.description: The collection of columns in the table.

properties.name: Rows
properties.description: The collection of rows in the table.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Default style name for the table.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Default paragraph formatting for the table.

properties.name: KeepTogether
properties.description: Flag indicating whether to keep all rows on the same page.

properties.name: Comment
properties.description: Optional comment associated with the table.

nested_classes.name: TableValues
nested_classes.description: Holds internal nullable property values for a Table, including columns, rows, style, padding, borders, shading, and comments.
